scope: Offline expansion of a learned foreground decoder into body and conditional paper-identity outputs. No training run, exported ONNX model or live-site behavior change.
invariants: First output retains learned body logits in float32 and float64.
Second output begins with zero logits and receives a nonzero material gradient.
Parent parameters and buffers are not aliased or mutated.
Encoder parameters and BatchNorm statistics stay unchanged through the tested decoder update.
Module training flags, feature gradient flags, dtype and initialization provenance are preserved.
Construction does not advance the CPU random stream.
